hand.title: Daily Hand

events.text: Your cards — 3, 9. Both players called a raise before the cards were dealt.
Turn — 10. Your opponent led out with a bet. You called.
River — King. Your opponent fired again — half the pot.

wrongReasons: With only high card, 7 9 wouldn't commit chips across multiple streets. This betting line requires a genuinely made hand from the flop onward.
With only one pair, 2 2 wouldn't commit chips across multiple streets. This betting line requires a genuinely made hand from the flop onward.
With only high card, 9 4 wouldn't commit chips across multiple streets. This betting line requires a genuinely made hand from the flop onward.
hand.explanation:
Answer: 2 4

Your opponent flopped a straight and immediately raised to build the pot. They led every remaining street — consistent value betting across all streets is a strong signal of a made hand.
